title: Real Alexa store icons per site (108 and 512 PNG)
description: Pilobolus has placeholder icons (a pale green 'P' on the dark theme), uploaded by Ryan on 2026-10-31 to s3://…sitebucket…/alexa/. Each site needs real 108x108 and 512x512 icons, chosen by Ryan, shipped in the site repository so the projection serves them at /alexa/icon-108.png and /alexa/icon-512.png. Amazon refuses to create a skill until both URLs resolve.
